subject: RM_QirraMat

reply.subject: RM_QirraMat

observed.single.png: A wide, flat, almost perfectly elliptical mat seen at a low angle. It is made of fleshy rust-red to maroon lobed plates separated by darker cracks that run out from a darker, glossier, wet-looking centre. The edge is a crinkled rim of plates with a thin dark outline. It has real alpha, with no soil, shadow or backdrop. It spans almost the full width of the canvas and about half its height, and there is no green anywhere.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom, beside the vanilla human, the mat covers most of one cell, lying flat on the ground and well under knee height. At normal play (32 px per cell) it reads as a small red-brown oval patch on the ground, next to the human and a small animal.

SIGNATURE.seen: A flat rosette of fleshy rust-maroon lobes and scale-plates with a darker, wet-looking centre, as described; no green.

READS_KIND.seen: It lies flat and low like ground cover; it does not read as a hill or a mound.

NATURAL.seen: The plates are irregular and cracked like organic tissue, though the outer outline is a very regular ellipse.

ANCHOR.seen: It lies flat at the bottom of the cell, centred, with nothing cut off.

NO_SCENERY.seen: Clean alpha around the mat, with no clay disc, shadow or halo.

ALIEN.seen: No obvious Earth plant: not a fungus, lichen, flower or succulent. At a glance it could pass for a cracked mud crust or a slab of meat, but nothing that names an Earth plant.

STYLE.seen: Painterly texture with shading and a fine dark rim; not cel-shaded or toy-like.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art; it does not match any vanilla or donor sprite.

FILLS.seen: It fills the canvas width; the height is about half the canvas, which is right for a flat mat seen at an angle.

SCALE.seen: Covers most of one cell and lies flat beside the human, which suits a ground crust.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px per cell it reads as a distinct red-brown flat patch.

VARIANTS.seen: Only one own picture is given; no variants panel.

findings.seen: A single picture for a ground cover; no random pool.
findings.quote: a ground cover or bush with ONE own picture wants a random pool — note WANTS_VARIANTS (polish)
findings.fix: Add two or three more variants of the qirra mat with different lobe layouts, irregular outlines and slightly different sizes and wetness at the centre.

findings.seen: The overall outline is an almost perfect, symmetric ellipse, so at a glance the mat reads a little like a rug or a patty rather than an organic spreading growth.
findings.fix: The mat's outline is irregular and asymmetric, with lobes spreading unevenly and some plates reaching out further on one side.

proposals: The meat-slab or cracked-mud reading could be lessened by a stronger gloss on the wet centre and a few raised, more fleshy lobe edges, which would sell 'opened by flood' better.
